To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) LIGHT is not required for the induction of influenza A virus-specific CD4+ and/or CD8+ T cells or antibodies, 2) the absence of LIGHT does not affect the maintenance of influenza A virus specific CD8+ T memory, and 3) LIGHT does not affect recall responses of CD8+ memory T cells to a secondary challenge with influenza A virus.
LIGHT plays a dispensable role in the acquired immune response against influenza A virus in C57BL/6 mice.
LIGHT is not required for CD4+ or CD8+ T cells responses to influenza A infection.
